footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Cannae: includes $11.7M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $224M of other items after tax, $97.9M of discontinued operations.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 6.4% to $424M in 2025. Gross margin was 15.5%, versus 18.0% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $120M from $104M.
The net loss widened to $513M, or −$9.08 per share, from $305M. Operating cash flow was −$18.1M and free cash flow −$28.5M, versus −$97.1M; Cannae returned $350M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Cannae Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
